purpose: This medication is used to treat Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder, commonly known as ADHD, in people 6 years and older. It helps improve focus, reduce hyperactivity, and control impulsive behavior. It is often used as part of a broader treatment plan that may include therapy and other support.
how_it_works: This medication contains two active ingredients that work together to increase the levels of certain natural chemicals in your brain, mainly dopamine and norepinephrine. These chemicals help your brain stay focused and organized. One ingredient, serdexmethylphenidate, releases slowly throughout the day for long-lasting effect, while dexmethylphenidate works more quickly to help right away in the morning.
common_side_effects: Common side effects include decreased appetite, trouble sleeping, stomach upset or nausea, headache, dry mouth, feeling irritable or anxious, increased heart rate, and weight loss with long-term use. Most of these tend to be mild and may improve over time.
warnings: This medication has a risk of abuse and dependence, so it should only be used exactly as prescribed. Tell your doctor if you have heart problems, high blood pressure, a history of mental health issues, or a personal or family history of substance misuse. It can raise blood pressure and heart rate, so regular check-ups are important. Do not take it if you are on certain antidepressants called MAO inhibitors. It may slow growth in children, so your doctor will monitor height and weight regularly.
typical_dosing: For children aged 6 and older and adults, the usual starting dose is one capsule of 26.1 mg/5.2 mg taken by mouth once in the morning. Your doctor may adjust the dose based on how well it works and how you tolerate it, up to a maximum of 52.3 mg/10.4 mg per day. The capsule can be swallowed whole or opened and sprinkled on food.
